# islahwebservice.com

> B2B lead generation services built around accurate prospect data. We research target companies, identify relevant decision-makers, enrich and verify contact information, and deliver CRM-ready prospect databases built around your targeting criteria.

Islah Web Service provides the research and data stage of B2B lead generation: company research, decision-maker discovery, contact enrichment, email verification, data cleaning, and CRM-ready delivery. Founded in 2016, the company serves managed service providers (MSPs), SaaS companies, recruitment firms, and B2B professional services across the USA, UK, and Australia. We build the data — your team controls the outreach.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2016
- Markets: USA, UK, Australia
- Clients: MSPs, SaaS, recruitment firms, professional services, B2B sales teams
- Core service: B2B prospect research (one service, applied across industries)
- Contact: hello@islahwebservice.com · +1 (442) 222-8258

## Services
- [B2B Prospect Research](https://www.islahwebservice.com/b2b-prospect-research): The core service — companies researched against your criteria, requested decision-makers identified, and contact data enriched, verified, and delivered CRM-ready.
- [Existing Database Enrichment](https://www.islahwebservice.com/contact-enrichment): Complete and clean an existing prospect or CRM list — missing emails, phone numbers, LinkedIn URLs, updated titles, verification, and deduplication.

## Industries
- [Managed Service Providers](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/msp): MSP lead generation services built on targeted company research by geography, size, and IT-related criteria.
- [SaaS Companies](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/saas): SaaS lead generation services built on accurate prospect data — stack, funding, and growth signals.
- [Recruitment Firms](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/recruitment): Recruitment lead generation built around hiring signals.
- [Professional Services](https://www.islahwebservice.com/industries/professional-services): Lead generation research for consultancies, agencies, and advisory firms.
